subject: Invoice origin & preferred delivery: portal opt-out request
messages:
From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@bridgecorp.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@bridgecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Who issues invoices to BridgeCorp (portal vs email)?

Hi Grace,

Quick question from our AP desk — are invoices for our account going to be created and sent by Redwood, or should BridgeCorp continue to generate the vendor invoice? We ran into a mismatch between our ERP and the invoice sender identity (it affects automated matching).

Also, our policy team prefers using our portal for invoice ingestion, but we've had a few vendors ask to opt-out of portal drops and just email PDFs. Can Redwood accommodate an email-only delivery for this integration? If yes, what metadata/tags do you include in the PDF to help our matching (PO number, bill-to entity tag, remit-to)?

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Martin
Sr. AP Analyst | BridgeCorp
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@bridgecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2027 09:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Who issues invoices to BridgeCorp (portal vs email?)

Hi Sophie — thanks for the note. Short answers up front:
- Redwood will act as the invoice originator for usage-based charges once you opt into our billing flow — we can sign and emit the invoice under Redwood Inference.
- We support both portal push (preferred for automated ingestion) and email delivery (PDF) as a fallback. Email-only delivery is possible, but there are tradeoffs for automated matching.

If you go email-only, we can embed the following as a structured header and visible fields in the PDF to help your ERP: PO:, Account ID:, Bill-to legal name, Remit-to alias, Invoice UUID. We can also append a short machine-readable invoice header (single-line JSON) in the PDF metadata if that helps.

I'm attaching a short sample (bridgecorp-invoice-template.pdf) showing the header + visible fields.

If BridgeCorp requires the vendor (you) to continue issuing invoices, we can instead switch to a credit-only arrangement where Redwood emits a monthly statement and BridgeCorp continues to bill. That is more manual and will complicate reconciliation.

Would you like me to enable email delivery for the first two invoices while your AP runs a test portal ingestion?

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2027 10:20:00 -04:00
Subject: Fwd: Who issues invoices to BridgeCorp (portal vs email?)

Ben / Connor — forwarding BridgeCorp's ask. Key points: they want clarity on invoice origin and are asking to opt out of portal ingestion and receive PDFs by email for initial invoices. They also asked what metadata we can include to help ERP matching.

Options I see:
1) Redwood emits invoices (recommended). Enable both portal push and email copy. Include structured single-line header and Invoice UUID in PDF metadata. This keeps control and consistent remit-to.
2) BridgeCorp continues issuing invoices; we switch to statement/credit model. More manual reconciliation; not ideal.

Operational asks: Ben — can we support the single-line JSON header and ensure the PDF metadata includes Invoice UUID and PO mapping? Connor — any objections from our billing system (templates or tax handling) to tagging the PDF with an explicit remit alias? Also, BridgeCorp is EU-facing for some entities — confirm VAT reverse-charge tagging if needed.

Grace
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Who issues invoices to BridgeCorp (portal vs email?)

Thanks Grace. Quick ops note:
- We can add a one-line machine-readable header inside the PDF (e.g., "RDW-INVOICE-META: {\"invoice_uuid\": \"...\", \"po\": \"...\", \"bill_to_id\": \"BRIDGE-123\"}"). That will not affect tax computations.
- PDF metadata (XMP) can carry the same invoice_uuid and remit alias; our PDF generator can be toggled per-account.
- For VAT: if BridgeCorp requires reverse-charge annotation, we already have a template flag to add the note and reference the customer's VAT id; Connor, we should confirm which legal entity (US vs EU) issues the invoice so the VAT block applies correctly.

Recommendation: enable both portal push (primary) and email PDF copy for the first 30 days. Set a metadata profile named "bridgecorp-ap-v1" that includes invoice_uuid, PO, bill_to_entity, remit_alias. I'll provision the template today.

Ben
Lead Billing Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@bridgecorp.com>, AP Team <ap@bridgecorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2027 14:30:00 -0400
Subject: Final: Invoice origin and delivery plan for BridgeCorp

Hi Sophie / AP Team — following internal ops confirmation, here's the plan we can put in place immediately: 

1) Redwood will be the invoice originator for BridgeCorp's Redwood usage (RDW-2481). Invoices will be signed and emitted by Redwood Inference.
2) Delivery: primary = portal push to your ingestion endpoint (we'll send an enrollment link: https://app.redwood.com/portal/enroll/BridgeCorp). Secondary = PDF copy by email to ap@bridgecorp.com for the first 30 days while you verify automated matching. After 30 days we'll review and can default to portal-only.
3) Metadata & matching: every PDF will include a one-line machine-readable header and XMP PDF metadata (fields: invoice_uuid, po_number, bill_to_entity, remit_alias). Template attached for your AP team (bridgecorp-invoice-template.pdf).
4) VAT: If any invoices are subject to reverse-charge, we'll add the legal VAT note and include your VAT ID on the invoice. Please confirm the bill-to legal entity and VAT ID if reverse-charge applies.

Next steps for your team: confirm whether you want Redwood to sign/issue invoices (yes / no) and, if yes, confirm bill-to legal name and VAT ID (if applicable). We'll provision the "bridgecorp-ap-v1" metadata profile once you confirm.

Best regards,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: bridgecorp-invoice-template.pdf
